subject: Re: SLA & premium support — questions on tiers, credits, and volume discounts
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha@skylark.ai>

Cc: Skylark.ai Procurement <procurement@skylark.ai>
Date: 2026-05-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SLA & premium support — initial questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team liked Redwood's predictability around latency and cost. Before we move into procurement, a couple of questions from our ops and legal teams about premium support and SLA packaging:

- Can you confirm the standard uptime tiers you sell (and how credits are calculated for each)?
- Typical response windows for Severity 1 / Severity 2 under each tier (business hours vs 24/7)?
- Do you offer blended pricing/discounts for a 3‑year committed spend (we expect to commit ~$600k/yr)?
- For regional failover events, are credits applied per-region or on a global blended basis?

Also: if you have a one‑page that lays out tiers, response times, and sample credit calculations, that would help our procurement team.

Appreciate it — aiming to finalize vendor short-list by the end of next week.

Best,
Asha Raman
Head of Infrastructure, Skylark.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SLA & premium support — initial questions

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Inline answers and a quick starter proposal below; attaching the one‑pager.

Summary of standard uptime tiers (examples):
- Gold (99.5%): standard credits (1% of monthly spend per 0.1% below target), response windows: Sev1 = 4h business hours, Sev2 = 24h
- Platinum (99.9%): stronger credits (2% per 0.05% below), response windows: Sev1 = 1h (business hours), Sev2 = 8h
- Enterprise (99.99%): highest credits (3% per 0.01% below), response windows: Sev1 = 15m (24/7), Sev2 = 2h (24/7)

Regional failover: credits are calculated against the affected region's capacity for multi‑region customers; we can offer a blended global calculation if you prefer a single credit view in the contract.

Discounting for multi‑year commit: for a 3‑year $600k/yr commit we typically offer a 12–18% volume discount depending on prepay vs. annual billing and whether you take a Dedicated capacity commitment.

Starter commercial options (monthly run‑rates, ballpark):
- Gold: $12k/mo (no volume discount applied)
- Platinum: $28k/mo (base)
- Enterprise: $75k/mo (includes 24/7 oncall rotation + priority X‑route)

Options we can customize: reducing response windows, combining a 99.95% blended tier (between Platinum & Enterprise), or offering a phased uplift where we start at Platinum and switch to Enterprise after 6 months.

Next steps: I can put together a concise proposal (with sample credit math) and loop in Jordan for escalation/Sales Engineering if you want a 99.95 blended quote. Marissa is cc'd to help on the commercial side.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

Attachment: skylark-sla-pricing-v1.pdf (pricing one‑pager)

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick summary. A few clarifications after I checked with my ops lead: 

- We actually need a 99.95% availability floor (a middle ground between Platinum and Enterprise). Would you price that as a custom blended tier and show credit math?
- For Sev1 we need a guaranteed 2‑hour response (not 1h), but we can accept 24/7 oncall for Sev1 only.
- Regarding discounts: can you show a price matrix for 1yr / 3yr / 3yr prepay? The legal team will want to see sample SLA credit calculations in the contract template too.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Skylark — counterproposal for 99.95 tier and commit discounts

Ben / Jordan — looping you both in with a draft counterproposal to land Skylark faster. Posting as an internal→external reply to keep the thread together.

Proposal (sketch):
- Custom tier: 99.95% uptime (blended).
- Response windows: Sev1 = 2 hours (24/7 oncall), Sev2 = 4 hours (business hours).
- Escalation coverage: 24/7 oncall + named escalation engineer during business hours; two‑week handover for oncall rotations.
- Credits: scaled slab: 5% of monthly invoice for the first 0.01% below 99.95, 10% thereafter up to 50% cap per month. (Detailed credit calc in attached doc.)
- Pricing (ballpark, monthly): Base Enterprise blended = $62k/mo.
- Volume discounts for commit: 1yr = 8% off list; 3yr annual billing = 15%; 3yr prepay = 20%.
- Onboarding/runbook: waiver of $18k onboarding fee for signed 3yr prepay or Dedicated capacity commit.
- One caveat: 24/7 named SE coverage included for first 12 months; after that it can convert to a retainer at a reduced rate.

Attachments: skylark-proposal-v2.pdf (detailed credit math + term sheet). Please review numbers, I left some room on pricing to negotiate.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercials | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
